name: taxdesk-os
description: Open-source practice management and ITR preparation system for Indian CA and tax offices: clients, cases, document collection, a deterministic AY 2026-27 income tax engine, validation, reviewer sign-off and filing readiness. Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/PostgreSQL with row-level security.
author: Aryan Madaan <aryanmadaan@gmail.com>

scripts.db:push:local: npm run db:guard && npx supabase db push --local --include-all
scripts.db:reset:local: npm run db:guard && npx supabase db reset --local
scripts.db:migration:up:local: npm run db:guard && npx supabase migration up --local
scripts.test:security: node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/hostile-postgrest.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/txn-atomicity.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/eligibility-gate.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/reviewer-signoff.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/ingestion-gates.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/storage-orphan-reconcile.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/source-proposal-workflow.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/surcharge-marginal-relief-blocker.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/evidence-manifest-workflow.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/senior-treatment-blocker.mjs && node --env-file=.env.local tests/security/presumptive-activity-snapshot-backstop.mjs
